text:
sam: Heads-up — running the sampleapp onboarding flow I hit a weird burst where pagination + prefetch caused a backlog and we started spamming 429s. Repro steps: new account, warmup traffic ~200 req/min, sampleapp prefetch enabled. :confused:

amy: ugh. do we have logs? sounds like prefetch isn’t respecting the client token window/backpressure.

sam: grabbing logs now. snippet from the client config used in prod-sim:```yaml
prefetch: 4
page_size: 50
max_concurrency: 12
client_window: 16
retry_policy:
  max_retries: 2
  backoff_ms: 200
```
logs: `2024-05-05T15:12:23Z WARN request=page-fetch id=5 status=429`, repeated ~30x over 10s, then memory climb on the sampleapp.

kelvin: is this the JS sampleapp or go? parity could matter — our go sdk uses token-bucket that lets small bursts, js has a strict semaphore.

sam: js sampleapp (nextjs). Verified locally with go client and js client — behavior differs. go smooths, js piles up.

amy: hmm — likely two issues: (1) prefetch window doesn't clamp to remaining token budget, and (2) retry/backoff doesn’t change prefetch when we see sustained 429s.

kelvin: proposed quick mitigation: clamp prefetch to `max(1, client_window // 4)` and add exponential jitter on retries, plus a simple circuit when 429 rate > 20% over 30s: stop prefetch for 60s.

sam: that would probably stop the memory ramp. I can prototype the clamp in sampleapp.

ci-bot: flaky-test-runner failed on `devex/sampleapp` integration: 1 test timeout. job: https://ci/reports/4821

amy: thanks CI. sam, when you push prototype, please also add an e2e that simulates 429 spikes so we don't regress.

sam: will do. quick patch idea (js sdk):```js
// clamp prefetch based on observed window
const effectivePrefetch = Math.max(1, Math.floor(config.client_window / 4));
prefetchQueue.setLimit(effectivePrefetch);
// backoff: increase delay after 429s
```

kelvin: also file an SDK parity issue — we should call out in the ticket that go+py have smoothing and js lacks it.

amy: agreed. add sampleapp readme note to recommend conservative prefetch for small accounts.

sam: assigning to myself. opening PR and ticket: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/482 (draft). ETA: today EOD.

kelvin: please include a short diagnostic flag for customers: header `X-RW-Debug: prefetch` that dumps in-flight counts to logs, will help support.

amy: nice idea. put it behind `DEBUG_PREFETCH=true` env var. :thumbsup:

sam: cool — adding that and the e2e. I’ll ping when draft is up.

kelvin: follow-up: add a short note to SDK docs under "client-side throttling" about prefetch/clamping & circuit rule.

amy: yep — I'll slot it into the devex docs backlog.

sam: thanks.
